@graph.name: Flower orders for florists in Europe | Flowers Overseas
@graph.description: We bring you orders from people abroad sending flowers home. You make and deliver them locally and receive a fixed amount per order, agreed in advance.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to work only with you?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You keep your shop, your customers and any other work you do.
No. There is no fee to join and no monthly fee.

mainEntity.name: What if I am full on a day?

acceptedAnswer.text: Decline the order. It costs you nothing.
We are. The buyer pays us, and any question or complaint comes to us. You never chase a payment.

mainEntity.name: Do I see the buyer's details?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. After you accept, you see what delivery needs: the recipient's name, phone number and address, the card message and the date.

mainEntity.name: What happens to the recipient's details after delivery?

acceptedAnswer.text: You use them only to deliver that order and do not keep them afterwards. Our agreement with you says so.

mainEntity.name: In which language do orders arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Polish, German or English, as you choose.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a registered business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We work with registered flower shops and florists, and we ask for your registration number when we speak.
Apply here, or call or message us first. We talk, agree what you receive for each bouquet, and send you a test order before a real one.
